title: AnalyticsMsg
description: Topic dev/{mid}/{did}/analytics, device to cloud, QoS 0. Device health metrics for the manufacturer fleet analytics: no user data. At most one message per 5 minutes; recommended hourly, plus one right after boot with reset_reason.

period_s.description: Length of the period the counters cover.

reset_reason.description: Why the device last restarted; send in the first message after boot.

crash.description: Details of the crash that caused the last restart (reset_reason panic or watchdog).

fw.description: Firmware that crashed (it may have been rolled back since).

heap_min_free_b.description: Lowest free heap since boot, bytes.

rssi_dbm.description: Average signal strength over the period.

publish_failures.description: MQTT publishes that failed or timed out in the period.

cmd_latency_ms.description: Average time from desired state received to reported, ms.

relay_cycles.description: Relay switching cycles in the period (wear).
